content:
The applications for the 1st call “SEED” of the METABUILDING project has a new deadline! The call will remain open until February 26!

We recall that METABUILDING has available up to 5000€ for innovative SMEs, whose innovation processes have application in the construction sector and with application in the areas of additive manufacturing, circular economy, nature-based and digital solutions.

Apply for this funding for the following innovation support services:

  • Mentoring for innovation.
  • Analysis of intellectual property rights.
  • Technical analysis and assistance.
  • Identification of partnerships or innovative technologies.
  • Obtaining information: partnerships and technologies.
  • Preparation of trans-sectorial business plans.
  • Preparation of market studies.

For more information check the METABUILDING website here.
